build.#: Split the way packages/cli's build:host is, and for the same reasons.

build:cargo.#: Always runs; `build` is what dependents read.

build:examples.#: Every example component plus the Zena platform component. Each also has a script of its own, so that editing one does not rebuild the others.

build:platform.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build packages/zenafx-platform/src/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/platform.wasm --target component --wit packages/zenafx/wit/deps/platform/platform.wit --world platform

build:widgets.#: Three widget classes composed in one component: a page of cards, one holding two labels in its slot.
build:widgets.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/widgets/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/widgets.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/widgets.wit --world app

build:counter.#: Two counters sharing one template, each writing a hole on its own timer.
build:counter.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/counter/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/counter.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/counter.wit --world app

build:button.#: A count, a button that adds one to it and a page that resets it: each listener is a stream the component reads.
build:button.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/button/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/button.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/button.wit --world app

build:scroll.#: Forty rows in a box that shows six: the list's box says its content scrolls, and the host does the rest.
build:scroll.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/scroll/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/scroll.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/scroll.wit --world app

build:split.#: Two panels and a divider the pointer drags: the divider captures the pointer, and the split writes one layout hole a move.
build:split.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/split/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/split.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/split.wit --world app

build:cursors.#: A tile for each cursor, each naming its own, to see them all by moving the pointer over them.
build:cursors.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/cursors/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/cursors.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/cursors.wit --world app

build:disclosure.#: Two summaries that show and hide the lines under them, from a press and from the keyboard.
build:disclosure.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/disclosure/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/disclosure.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/disclosure.wit --world app

build:input.#: Two text fields written in Zena: the editing is the component's, and the host draws the caret, says where a press landed in the text, and keeps the caret in sight.
build:input.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/input/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/input.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/input.wit --world app

build:selection.#: A page of text to select and copy, a button whose label is left out, and a field to paste into.
build:selection.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/selection/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/selection.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/selection.wit --world app

build:richtext.#: Paragraphs of text in more than one style: each is a flow container, whose text nodes the host lays out as one piece of text.
build:richtext.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/richtext/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/richtext.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/richtext.wit --world app

build:directives.#: Guest directives (`cache` and `repeat`) driven by `create-node` and `set-slot`.
build:directives.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/directives/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/directives.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/directives.wit --world app

build:styles.#: End-to-end `@ui` guest component exercising `zenafx:host/style@0.1.0` served by the platform component.
build:styles.command: mkdir -p out && cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena build examples/zenafx/styles/main.zena -o packages/zenafx/out/styles.wasm --target component --wit examples/zenafx/styles.wit --world app

test:editing.#: The text field's editing, which needs no host: `examples/zenafx/input/editing.zena`.
